_readme: Shipped updates, newest first. Add an entry when something ships: date (YYYY-MM-DD), product, what changed in one plain sentence, and an optional one-line founder note. The build turns this into /changelog/ and shows the three newest on the homepage.

entries.title: Screens to strict AAOIFI Standard 21 limits
entries.detail: Interest-bearing debt and cash plus interest-bearing securities now cap at 30% of market cap, and the receivables test is gone. The full screening method is published on the pricing page.

entries.title: Minimum-volume filter, and open any symbol in your own charts
entries.detail: The live scan takes an optional minimum volume, and any symbol on the board opens in the charting platform you already use.

entries.title: Nightly compliance re-screen
entries.detail: Every stock is re-screened each night against its latest filed financial statements, so a verdict changes within a day of new results.

entries.title: The 3T Pro Scanner board on the Halal universe
entries.detail: The same terminal as the 3T Pro Scanner, running only on stocks that pass the Halal screen.

entries.title: TradingView charts, one click from any table
entries.detail: Click any symbol in any table to load its chart.
